select mmwo.id, mmwo.tenant_code, mmwo.work_order_no, mmwo.order_no, mmwo.word_order_type, mmwo.product_seq, mmwo.wshop_code, mmwo.mline_code, mmwo.work_order_num, mmwo.delivery_date, mmwo.plan_start_date, mmwo.plan_end_date, mmwo.produce_start_date, mmwo.produce_end_date, mmwo.work_order_status, mmwo.before_status, mmwo.remark, mmwo.send_by, mmwo.send_date, mmwo.inbound_date, mmwo.finish_num, mmwo.ng_num, mmwo.close_reason, mmwo.extend_content, mmwo.created_by, mmwo.created_date, mmwo.last_upd_by, mmwo.last_upd_date, mmwo.active_flag, mmwo.main_flag, mmwo.is_complete, mp.id as product_id, mp.product_code , mp.product_name , mp.unit, mp.product_type, mp.production_mode, mw.wshop_name , mml.mline_name, mmt.pass_num, mmt.tech_type from micro_manufacture_work_order mmwo left join micro_product mp on mmwo.product_seq = mp.product_seq left join micro_workshop mw on mmwo.wshop_code = mw.wshop_code left join micro_manufacture_line mml on mmwo.mline_code = mml.mline_code left join micro_manufacture_task mmt on mmt.work_order_no=mmwo.work_order_no and mmt.is_last_process='0'

select mmwo.id, mmwo.tenant_code, mmwo.work_order_no, mmwo.order_no, mmwo.word_order_type, mmwo.product_seq, mmwo.wshop_code, mmwo.mline_code, mmwo.work_order_num, mmwo.delivery_date, mmwo.plan_start_date, mmwo.plan_end_date, mmwo.produce_start_date, mmwo.produce_end_date, mmwo.work_order_status, mmwo.before_status, mmwo.remark, mmwo.send_by, mmwo.send_date, mmwo.inbound_date, mmwo.finish_num, mmwo.ng_num, mmwo.close_reason, mmwo.extend_content, mmwo.created_by, mmwo.created_date, mmwo.last_upd_by, mmwo.last_upd_date, mmwo.active_flag, mmwo.main_flag, mmo.plan_num, mp.product_code , mp.product_name , mp.unit, mc.customer_name as ow_name from micro_manufacture_work_order mmwo left join micro_product mp on mmwo.product_seq = mp.product_seq left join micro_manufacture_order mmo on mmwo .order_no = mmo.order_no left join micro_customer mc on mc.customer_code = mmo.ow_code

SELECT t.work_order_no as workOrderNo, mp.tenant_code as tenantCode, mp.id as productId, mp.product_seq as productSeq, mp.product_code as productCode, mp.product_name as productName, mp.unit as productUnit, t.work_order_num as workOrderNum, round((t.work_order_num * pb2.product_number), 4) AS demandNum, t.plan_start_date as planStartDate, t.plan_end_date as planEndDate FROM (SELECT w.work_order_no, MAX(w.plan_start_date) as plan_start_date, MAX(w.plan_end_date) as plan_end_date, SUM(w.work_order_num) as work_order_num, w.tenant_code, pb.product_seq FROM micro_manufacture_work_order w LEFT JOIN micro_product_bom pb ON w.tenant_code = pb.tenant_code AND w.product_seq = pb.product_seq WHERE pb.bom_type = 'STANDARD' AND pb.parent_id = '0' AND w.plan_start_date >= #{condition.planStartDate} AND w.plan_start_date <= #{condition.planEndDate} AND w.work_order_status IN ('10', '20') GROUP BY w.work_order_no, pb.product_seq, w.tenant_code) AS t LEFT JOIN micro_product_bom pb2 ON t.tenant_code = pb2.tenant_code AND t.product_seq = pb2.parent_product_seq LEFT JOIN micro_product mp ON pb2.product_seq = mp.product_seq AND pb2.tenant_code = mp.tenant_code ORDER BY t.plan_start_date
